question: Should Browser CLI `--fields-file` become a hard 1 MiB-limited public input contract for existing users?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but choosing a new rejection threshold changes the accepted CLI input set and cannot be inferred safely from the current unbounded behavior.

options.title: Approve a documented limit
options.body: Confirm the 1 MiB limit as supported Browser CLI policy and require user-facing documentation plus boundary and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Preserve existing compatibility
options.body: Do not impose this hard cap until a resource-bound design can avoid rejecting currently valid fields files.

recommendation.title: Approve a documented limit
recommendation.body: Confirm the 1 MiB limit as supported Browser CLI policy and require user-facing documentation plus boundary and upgrade coverage.
